sources.rawText:
[Page 1]
Smart Campus Management System — Architecture Specification v2.1. Decision DEC-01: Adopt PostgreSQL 16 with TimescaleDB extension as the unified telemetry and relational store instead of maintaining separate MongoDB and MySQL clusters. Rationale: Consolidating onto PostgreSQL eliminates cross-database sync lag during peak class-change RFID bursts and reduces operational maintenance overhead for the two-person DevOps team.

[Page 2]
IoT Ingestion & Security Architecture. Decision DEC-02: Migrate classroom occupancy sensors from HTTP polling to EMQX MQTT broker over TLS. Production MQTT broker runs on TLS port 8883 with mutual client certificates issued by the Campus Internal PKI. Dependency DEP-01: Firmware v3.4 OTA rollout depends on Campus Internal PKI issuing 420 device X.509 certificates before block deployment.

[Page 3]
Identity & API Gateway Layer. Decision DEC-03: Replace custom JWT session issuer with University Central OIDC Federation via Kong API Gateway. Rationale: Central OIDC federation enforces university-wide MFA and instant student graduation revocation without duplicating credential tables. Technical Setup: Staging API gateway is deployed at https://gw-staging.smartcampus.edu with PostgreSQL connection string stored in Vault path kv/smartcampus/staging.

[Page 4]
Event Bus & Alerting. Dependency DEP-02: Real-time occupancy dashboard WebSocket alerts depend on Redis 7.2 Pub/Sub cluster remaining pinned in ap-south-1 availability zone A. Important Contact: University Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead Dr. Ramesh Iyer (noc-lead@campus.edu, ext. 4410) manages VLAN 42 firewall whitelisting for IoT gateways.

[Section 1]
Security & Compliance Audit Notes — Prepared by Arjun Mehta (Information Security). Scope: Student RFID attendance PII handling, API gateway perimeter, and disaster recovery posture.

[Section 2]
Risk RSK-01 (High): Student RFID badge UIDs are currently logged alongside timestamp and room ID in unencrypted CSV exports during manual troubleshooting, creating student privacy and FERPA/DPDP exposure if exported files leave the bastion host.

[Section 3]
Risk RSK-02 (Critical): Single point of failure on campus-mqtt-01 broker node. No automated failover replica is provisioned; if the primary node restarts during 09:00 AM class check-in, up to 12,000 attendance punches could be dropped.

[Section 4]
Pending Approval APP-01: Data Protection Officer (DPO) Meera Krishnan (dpo@campus.edu) sign-off on the 90-day raw telemetry retention policy is pending review since October 19, blocking production go-live of the analytics archive.

[Section 5]
Risk RSK-03 (Medium): Vendor EduSense firmware signing keys are stored only on Pooja Ravi engineering workstation HSM backup without dual-custody escrow. Key transfer to Incoming Member and Security Vault is mandatory prior to offboarding.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content: The Smart Campus Management System is currently In Progress toward its December 20, 2026 milestone. Core database (PostgreSQL 16 + TimescaleDB) and Kong Gateway rate-limiting layers are operational in staging. However, two critical discrepancies require reviewer sign-off before production cutover: (1) Campus SSO OIDC integration is flagged Completed in Sprint 14 CSV yet reported In Progress in Oct 28 engineering minutes awaiting Central IT metadata, and (2) Staging MQTT operates unauthenticated on port 1883 due to expired certs while production requires mTLS on port 8883.

sections.title: Project Background
sections.content: Initiated on June 15, 2026 under Program Lead Sandhya S, this initiative unifies classroom IoT occupancy sensing, RFID student attendance, OIDC identity federation, and campus energy telemetry across 14 academic blocks. Pooja Ravi served as Lead Backend & IoT Engineer through November 30 and is transitioning infrastructure, PKI certificate workflows, and HSM firmware escrow to Pooja G.

sections.title: Current Project Status

sections.title: Important Decisions and Their Rationale
sections.content:
1. DEC-01 (PostgreSQL 16 + TimescaleDB): Chosen over separate MongoDB/MySQL clusters to eliminate cross-DB sync lag and reduce DevOps toil.
2. DEC-02 (EMQX MQTT over TLS 8883): Adopted with mutual client certs for classroom sensors (note staging conflict on port 1883).
3. DEC-03 (University OIDC via Kong): Chosen over custom JWT to enforce campus MFA and instant graduation revocation.
4. DEC-04 (attendance_events Schema Freeze until Nov 25): [Needs Review — verbal agreement without recorded technical rationale].
5. DEC-05 (Secondary Datacenter Read-Only Mirror): Required for accreditation continuity during weekend power substation maintenance.

sections.content:

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.content:
• DEP-01: Firmware v3.4 OTA rollout depends on Campus Internal PKI issuing 420 device X.509 certificates.

• APP-01: Analytics archive production go-live depends on DPO Meera Krishnan sign-off on 90-day retention policy.
• Network Dependency: IoT gateway traffic requires VLAN 42 firewall whitelisting managed by NOC.

sections.title: Risks and Mitigation
sections.content:
• RSK-01 (High — PII/DPDP Exposure): Unencrypted CSV troubleshooting exports contain student RFID UIDs. Mitigation: Restrict exports to encrypted bastion sessions and purge scratch CSVs.
• RSK-02 (Critical — Broker SPOF): campus-mqtt-01 lacks an automated failover replica, risking 12,000 dropped check-ins at 09:00 AM. Mitigation: Provision active-passive EMQX cluster before December launch.
• RSK-03 (Medium — Key Custody): EduSense firmware signing keys reside only on Pooja Ravi HSM backup. Mitigation: Execute dual-custody transfer to Security Vault and Pooja G before Nov 29.
